title: Witch on the Holy Night Film's Trailer Previews supercell's Theme Song
content: Crunchyroll began streaming on Tuesday a trailer for the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film , and it previews the theme song "Yoru to Ao" (Night and Blue) by supercell . The film will open in Japan on November 20.

title: Bleach Creator Debuts New Soul Reapers With Surprising Anime Opening After Finale – Watch
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has aired its final episode after 22 long years of the anime franchise, but the surprises are still coming as the franchise has returned with a new anime opening showing off a whole new roster of Soul Reapers designed by the original creator himself.

title: Shaman King's Hiroyuki Takei Designs Short Net Anime Mecha Samurai
content: TV Tokyo announced on Monday that it is collaborating with the short net anime production company Plott to produce Mecha Samurai , a new short anime that will stream on YouTube and other online services starting in November. Shaman King creator Hiroyuki Takei drafted the anime's original main character designs.

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun: IruMafia Edition Anime Main Visual and January 4 Revealed
content: The spin-off anime Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun: IruMafia Edition revealed the main visual, along with a January 4, 2027 premiere. The series will run for 12 episodes, with six character visuals also revealed. The franchise also has its first theatrical anime film project in development.
